subject: Battery
route: gpt_consult.py (GPT via Codex) on a judge sheet with a vanilla colonist at the same 128 px per cell; the judge did not make the art. Round 1 (all pictures; an earlier round without the scale panel returned UNSURE on every picture and decided nothing), rounds 2-3 a fresh read of the Modern set after each redraw. Stopped after round 3: a picture still REDO is not installed.

verdicts.notes: Horizontal battery bank reads at play zoom. Rusted casing, mismatched cells, straps and exposed wiring establish Scrapper. Visible casing depth, footprint and transparent edges pass; no drawn black keyline.
Vertical bank retains the east facing's salvaged cells, rusty tray, palette and apparent size. Raised casing remains readable beside the colonist and at play zoom. No visible alpha defect.

Horizontal storage unit has readable terminals, heavy chamfered steel, ribs and restrained hazard markings. Industrial look is recognisable at play zoom. Casing depth, scale and transparent silhouette pass.

Vertical unit preserves the paired panels, terminals, ribs, material palette and substantial size of its east partner. Recognisable at play zoom, with visible casing thickness and clean transparent edges.
Recognisable Modern utility hardware with a horizontal long axis, plausible building perspective, clean transparency and a readable silhouette at play zoom.
Modern materials, vertical orientation and clean transparency pass. The facing pair fails the same-object size requirement.
verdicts.quote: Facings agree on size, proportions and palette; one facing looking huge or small is REDO.
verdicts.seen: At the same displayed cell scale, the north enclosure is conspicuously narrower and smaller than its east partner: its long silhouette is approximately 110 sheet pixels versus approximately 180 for east. Its narrow top and tall front also change the enclosure's proportions, making it read as a smaller cabinet.
verdicts.redo_brief: Redraw north as the same full-size enclosure shown in east, preserving its physical length, width, height and hardware while projecting the long axis up-down with the specified building camera.

verdicts.notes: Horizontal silver-white body, graphite end caps and thin cyan strips clearly establish Futuristic. Battery silhouette and central inset survive play zoom. Rounded housing has visible depth, clean transparency and no drawn black keyline.
